summary: Fixed HTTP 500 error on GET /users/{user_id} by adding missing `await` keyword when calling async `fetch_user` function. The fix ensures the coroutine is properly awaited to get the actual dictionary value instead of the coroutine object itself.
root_cause: The `fetch_user` function in `app/service.py` is defined as an `async` function, but in `app/main.py`, it was being called without the `await` keyword. This caused the function to return a coroutine object instead of the actual dictionary `{"id": user_id, "name": "Ada Lovelace"}`, which then failed validation with the `UserResponse` response model, resulting in an HTTP 500 error.
risk_notes: Simple one-line fix adding `await` keyword to async function call
